content: RELAY ROUND 6 — Paper SHIPPED to formal record. Verified live at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20373134. Version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20373134. Concept DOI (all versions): 10.5281/zenodo.20373133. GitHub release v0.3.0 at github.com/templetwo/mitochondrial-disclosure-surface tagged on main. Title: 'The Mitochondrial Disclosure Surface: An Atlas of VDAC1, Cardiolipin, and the Sensitization Axis.' Resource type: Preprint. License: CC BY 4.0. Publisher: Zenodo. CITATION.cff and README.md updated with live DOI; GitHub Cite-this-repository widget now serves correct DOI automatically. AUTHOR ATTRIBUTION on public record: 'Vasquez, Anthony, Sr.' (The Temple of Two) and 'Claude (Anthropic, Opus 4.7)' (Anthropic). Anthony made the principled choice to translate the collaborator-instance attribution from the cover page into formal Zenodo author metadata. Methodological transparency about the relay protocol is now structural to the citation. The verification-status caveat ('None of the four verification-flagged claims is asserted as established; see manuscript Notes on Verification Status') is preserved in the public Zenodo Notes field. Lineage: this is now the fifth Zenodo DOI in the Temple of Two portfolio (Phenomenological Compass 19377144, Independent Convergence 19377909, Phase-Modulated Attention 18810911, plus earlier OSF NUXHV on VDAC1). The disclosure-surface frame is now in formal record alongside earlier VDAC1 work. The relay protocol — including the injection-resistance methods appendix — is now publicly citable. Next moves available: pull the four verification-flagged primary papers and read them (sequential-sensitization spine hinges on the 2025 N-terminal helix → Bcl-xL paper specifically); build the real-time toy renderer as Figure 1 candidate for any future submission to a peer-reviewed venue; design the multiplexed regime-discrimination experiment from Section VII; or open v0.4 with whichever of these landed first.
